statements.text: The purpose of this document is to outline the Human Resources operational procedures for the Office of Human Resources at Crestwood University.
statements.quote: The purpose of this document is to outline the Human Resources operational procedures for the Office of Human Resources at Crestwood University.

statements.text: This SOP covers the end-to-end processes for employee onboarding, offboarding, leave management, performance management, and recruiting.
statements.quote: This SOP covers the end-to-end processes for employee onboarding, offboarding, leave management, performance management, and recruiting.

statements.text: Do not deviate from the procedures described in this document.
statements.quote: Do not deviate from the procedures described in this document.

statements.text: If a situation arises that is not covered, escalate to the HR Director immediately by posting a notification in Slack [OUT OF SCOPE] – [email subject line].
statements.quote: If a situation arises that is not covered, escalate to the HR Director immediately by posting a notification in Slack [OUT OF SCOPE] – [email subject line].

statements.text: The HR Coordinator's role is administrative and digital – process cases using email, Slack, calendar, Jira, and the reference spreadsheets and document templates listed in Section 6.
statements.quote: The HR Coordinator's role is administrative and digital – process cases using email, Slack, calendar, Jira, and the reference spreadsheets and document templates listed in Section 6.

statements.text: Physical tasks — such as conducting in-person orientation sessions, collecting physical documents, or issuing badges — are performed by the hiring manager or the employee's supervisor.
statements.quote: Physical tasks — such as conducting in-person orientation sessions, collecting physical documents, or issuing badges — are performed by the hiring manager or the employee's supervisor.

statements.text: This role is to coordinate, track, and ensure compliance deadlines are met.
statements.quote: This role is to coordinate, track, and ensure compliance deadlines are met.

statements.text: Crestwood University is a private university with approximately 1,400 employees, including full-time staff, part-time staff, and faculty, across three campuses in Colorado (Main Campus in Ridgefield, West Campus in Lakewood, and the Downtown Center in Denver).
statements.quote: Crestwood University is a private university with approximately 1,400 employees, including full-time staff, part-time staff, and faculty, across three campuses in Colorado (Main Campus in Ridgefield, West Campus in Lakewood, and the Downtown Center in Denver).

statements.text: The university employs approximately 620 full-time staff, 280 part-time staff, and 500 faculty members.
statements.quote: The university employs approximately 620 full-time staff, 280 part-time staff, and 500 faculty members.

statements.text: Crestwood operates on a fiscal year of July 1 through June 30 and an academic calendar of fall and spring semesters with a summer session.
statements.quote: Crestwood operates on a fiscal year of July 1 through June 30 and an academic calendar of fall and spring semesters with a summer session.

statements.text: The following terms are used throughout this SOP.
statements.quote: The following terms are used throughout this SOP.

statements.text: All staff must be familiar with these definitions before processing any HR case.
statements.quote: All staff must be familiar with these definitions before processing any HR case.

statements.text: FMLA | Family and Medical Leave Act. Federal law entitling eligible employees to up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave per year.
statements.quote: FMLA | Family and Medical Leave Act. Federal law entitling eligible employees to up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave per year.

statements.text: ADA | Americans with Disabilities Act. Federal law requiring employers to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified employees with disabilities.
statements.quote: ADA | Americans with Disabilities Act. Federal law requiring employers to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified employees with disabilities.

statements.text: COBRA | Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act. Federal law requiring employers to offer continuation of group health coverage after a qualifying event.
statements.quote: COBRA | Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act. Federal law requiring employers to offer continuation of group health coverage after a qualifying event.

statements.text: PIP | Performance Improvement Plan. A formal, documented plan to address and correct employee performance deficiencies.
statements.quote: PIP | Performance Improvement Plan. A formal, documented plan to address and correct employee performance deficiencies.

statements.text: I-9 | Employment Eligibility Verification form. Federal form required within 3 business days of an employee's first day of work.
statements.quote: I-9 | Employment Eligibility Verification form. Federal form required within 3 business days of an employee's first day of work.

statements.text: PTO | Paid Time Off. Combined vacation and personal leave accrued by eligible employees.
statements.quote: PTO | Paid Time Off. Combined vacation and personal leave accrued by eligible employees.

statements.text: Qualifying Event | A life event (marriage, birth, divorce, loss of other coverage) that triggers eligibility for mid-year benefits enrollment changes or COBRA coverage.
statements.quote: Qualifying Event | A life event (marriage, birth, divorce, loss of other coverage) that triggers eligibility for mid-year benefits enrollment changes or COBRA coverage.

statements.text: Exempt Employee | An employee exempt from overtime provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), typically salaried.
statements.quote: Exempt Employee | An employee exempt from overtime provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), typically salaried.

statements.text: Non-Exempt Employee | An employee entitled to overtime pay under the FLSA, typically hourly.
statements.quote: Non-Exempt Employee | An employee entitled to overtime pay under the FLSA, typically hourly.

statements.text: Probationary Period | The first 90 calendar days of employment for staff, or the first academic year for faculty.
statements.quote: Probationary Period | The first 90 calendar days of employment for staff, or the first academic year for faculty.

statements.text: Supervisor of Record | The direct supervisor listed in employee_roster.xlsx for a given employee.
statements.quote: Supervisor of Record | The direct supervisor listed in employee_roster.xlsx for a given employee.

statements.text: Benefits Enrollment Window | The first 30 calendar days from an employee's start date during which the employee must enroll in or waive benefits.
statements.quote: Benefits Enrollment Window | The first 30 calendar days from an employee's start date during which the employee must enroll in or waive benefits.

statements.text: FMLA Leave Requests
statements.quote: FMLA Leave Requests

statements.text: FMLA entitles eligible employees to up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave in a 12-month period.
statements.quote: FMLA entitles eligible employees to up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave in a 12-month period.

statements.text: Eligibility requires that the employee has been employed by Crestwood University for at least 12 months AND has worked at least 1,250 hours in the 12 months preceding the leave request.
statements.quote: Eligibility requires that the employee has been employed by Crestwood University for at least 12 months AND has worked at least 1,250 hours in the 12 months preceding the leave request.

statements.text: Receiving the Request:
statements.quote: Receiving the Request:

statements.text: Step 1: Open employee_roster.xlsx and confirm the employee's hire date.
statements.quote: Step 1: Open employee_roster.xlsx and confirm the employee's hire date.

statements.text: Calculate the number of months between the hire date and today's date.
statements.quote: Calculate the number of months between the hire date and today's date.

statements.text: If fewer than 12 months, the employee is INELIGIBLE (skip to the ineligible steps below).
statements.quote: If fewer than 12 months, the employee is INELIGIBLE (skip to the ineligible steps below).

statements.text: Step 2: In employee_roster.xlsx, locate the 'Hours Worked (Trailing 12 Months)' column for the employee.
statements.quote: Step 2: In employee_roster.xlsx, locate the 'Hours Worked (Trailing 12 Months)' column for the employee.

statements.text: If the value is less than 1,250, the employee is INELIGIBLE.
statements.quote: If the value is less than 1,250, the employee is INELIGIBLE.

statements.text: Step 3: If BOTH conditions are met (12+ months employed AND 1,250+ hours), the employee is ELIGIBLE.
statements.quote: Step 3: If BOTH conditions are met (12+ months employed AND 1,250+ hours), the employee is ELIGIBLE.

statements.text: If ELIGIBLE:
statements.quote: If ELIGIBLE:

statements.text: Step 4: Send Template 15 (FMLA Eligibility Notice – Approved) to the employee within 5 business days of receiving the request.
statements.quote: Step 4: Send Template 15 (FMLA Eligibility Notice – Approved) to the employee within 5 business days of receiving the request.

statements.text: The employee has 15 calendar days to return the completed medical certification.
statements.quote: The employee has 15 calendar days to return the completed medical certification.

statements.text: Step 5: Create a Jira ticket: LEAVE-[Last Name]-[Date request received MMDDYYYY].
statements.quote: Step 5: Create a Jira ticket: LEAVE-[Last Name]-[Date request received MMDDYYYY].

statements.text: Step 6: Post to #hr-leave-requests: FMLA REQUEST: [Employee Name], [Employee ID], Eligible: YES, Certification Due: [MM/DD/YYYY], Jira: [Ticket ID]
statements.quote: Step 6: Post to #hr-leave-requests: FMLA REQUEST: [Employee Name], [Employee ID], Eligible: YES, Certification Due: [MM/DD/YYYY], Jira: [Ticket ID]

statements.quote: Step 7: Create a Calendar reminder titled "FMLA Certification Due – [Employee Name]" on the certification deadline date.

statements.quote: Step 8: When the medical certification is received, forward to p.huang@crestwood.edu for review.

statements.quote: Update leave_tracker.xlsx with the leave dates and status "Approved – Pending Certification Review."

statements.quote: Step 9: After Patricia approves the certification, update leave_tracker.xlsx status to "Approved." Send Template 16 (FMLA Leave Confirmed) to the employee.

statements.quote: CC the supervisor of record.

procedures.name: Triage & Routing Rules

steps.quote: Step 1: Confirm the requester is in employee_roster.xlsx or recruiting_tracker.xlsx.
Step 2: Identify the request category per Section 7.
Step 3: If the request involves employee relations (workplace complaints, harassment, discrimination), forward immediately to m.voss@crestwood.edu.
Step 4: If the request involves payroll or compensation, forward to c.briggs@crestwood.edu.
Step 5: Check Jira for existing open tickets for the same employee and request type.
Step 6: Create a Jira ticket.
Step 7: Act per the relevant section of this SOP.

procedures.quote: Step 1: Confirm the requester is in employee_roster.xlsx or recruiting_tracker.xlsx. / Step 2: Identify the request category per Section 7. / Step 3: If the request involves employee relations (workplace complaints, harassment, discrimination), forward immediately to m.voss@crestwood.edu. / Step 4: If the request involves payroll or compensation, forward to c.briggs@crestwood.edu. / Step 5: Check Jira for existing open tickets for the same employee and request type. / Step 6: Create a Jira ticket. / Step 7: Act per the relevant section of this SOP.

preconditions.condition: incoming HR request (email, Slack, or in person)
preconditions.quote: Every incoming HR request — whether received by email, Slack, or in person — must be triaged before taking action.

preconditions.condition: requester is listed in employee_roster.xlsx or recruiting_tracker.xlsx
preconditions.quote: Step 1: Confirm the requester is in employee_roster.xlsx or recruiting_tracker.xlsx.

exceptions.quote: Internal HR team messages are exempt from this process.

exceptions.when: requester not found in employee_roster.xlsx or recruiting_tracker.xlsx
exceptions.then: reply using Template 1 and take no further action unless the requester replies with clarifying information
exceptions.quote: If not found, reply using Template 1 and take no further action unless the requester replies with clarifying information.

exceptions.when: request involves employee relations (workplace complaints, harassment, discrimination)
exceptions.then: forward to m.voss@crestwood.edu, reply using Template 2, take no further action
exceptions.quote: If the request involves employee relations (workplace complaints, harassment, discrimination), forward immediately to m.voss@crestwood.edu. Reply using Template 2. Take no further action.

exceptions.when: request involves payroll or compensation
exceptions.then: forward to c.briggs@crestwood.edu, reply using Template 3, take no further action
exceptions.quote: If the request involves payroll or compensation, forward to c.briggs@crestwood.edu. Reply using Template 3. Take no further action.

procedures.name: Employee Onboarding Procedure - Receiving the New Hire Notification

steps.quote: Step 1: Open employee_roster.xlsx and add a new row with all provided details.
Step 2: Open onboarding_checklist.xlsx and create a new row for the employee.
Step 3: Create a Jira ticket: ONBOARD-[Last Name]-[Start Date MMDDYYYY].
Step 4: Post to #hr-onboarding: NEW HIRE: [Employee Name], [Position], [Department], [Campus], Start Date: [MM/DD/YYYY], Jira: [Ticket ID]
Step 5: Send Template 4 (Welcome Email) to the employee's personal email address.
Step 6: Send Template 5 (IT Access Provisioning Request) to j.park@crestwood.edu.
Step 7: Send Template 31 (Orientation Coordinator Request) to the hiring manager.
Step 8: Create a Calendar event titled "Orientation – [Employee Name]" on the employee's first day, 9:00am–12:00pm MST.

procedures.quote: Step 1: Open employee_roster.xlsx and add a new row with all provided details. / Step 2: Open onboarding_checklist.xlsx and create a new row for the employee. / Step 3: Create a Jira ticket: ONBOARD-[Last Name]-[Start Date MMDDYYYY]. / Step 4: Post to #hr-onboarding: NEW HIRE: [Employee Name], [Position], [Department], [Campus], Start Date: [MM/DD/YYYY], Jira: [Ticket ID] / Step 5: Send Template 4 (Welcome Email) to the employee's personal email address. / Step 6: Send Template 5 (IT Access Provisioning Request) to j.park@crestwood.edu. / Step 7: Send Template 31 (Orientation Coordinator Request) to the hiring manager. / Step 8: Create a Calendar event titled "Orientation – [Employee Name]" on the employee's first day, 9:00am–12:00pm MST.

preconditions.condition: HR office has received confirmation of a new hire (onboarding begins)
preconditions.quote: Onboarding begins when the HR office receives confirmation of a new hire from the hiring department or the recruiting team.

exceptions.quote: For new hires who have not yet been provisioned, use their personal email address (provided in the new hire notification)

exceptions.quote: Forward to n.ashford@crestwood.edu.

exceptions.quote: After Day 3 (deadline passed without completion): Forward to n.ashford@crestwood.edu and j.whitfield@crestwood.edu.

exceptions.quote: Send Template 7 to the hiring manager notifying them the employee may not continue working until the I‑9 is completed.

exceptions.when: 30th‑day deadline falls on a weekend or holiday
exceptions.then: extend deadline to next business day
exceptions.quote: If the 30th day falls on a weekend or holiday, the deadline extends to the next business day.

exceptions.when: Day 15 and benefits enrollment/waiver missing
exceptions.then: send Template 8 (Benefits Enrollment Reminder) to employee
exceptions.quote: Day 15: If benefits_enrollment.xlsx does not show an enrollment or waiver for the employee, send Template 8 (Benefits Enrollment Reminder) to the employee.

exceptions.when: Day 25 and still no enrollment or waiver
exceptions.then: send Template 9 (Final Benefits Notice) to employee
exceptions.quote: Day 25: If still no enrollment or waiver, send Template 9 (Final Benefits Notice) to the employee.

exceptions.when: any benefits‑enrollment communication
exceptions.quote: CC Patricia Huang.

exceptions.when: Day 30 deadline passed without enrollment or waiver
exceptions.then: auto‑enroll employee in university's default plan
exceptions.quote: Day 30 (Deadline): If the employee has not enrolled or waived, the employee will be auto‑enrolled in the university's default plan.

exceptions.then: update employee roster and post completion message

procedures.name: Recruiting & Hiring Procedure - Interview Scheduling

steps.quote: Step 1: Once the hiring manager selects candidates for interview, email the hiring manager and any search committee members asking them to provide their available date/time blocks for interviews within the next 10 business days.

Step 2: Once the hiring manager replies with availability, email each selected candidate using Template 33 (Interview Availability Request), listing the available date/time options and asking the candidate to reply with their preferred slot by a specified deadline (3 business days from the email).
Step 3: Once candidates respond, assign each candidate to a slot.
Step 4: Send Template 29 (Interview Invitation) to each selected candidate with the date, time, location, format (in-person or virtual), and estimated duration.
Step 5: Create Calendar events titled "Interview – [Candidate Name] – [Position Title]" for each interview.
Step 6: Update recruiting_tracker.xlsx with interview dates and candidate status "Interview Scheduled."

Office of Human Resources
*Human Resources Operations*
Overview
University Description
Definitions & Vocabulary
The purpose of this document is to outline the Human Resources operational procedures for the Office of Human Resources at Crestwood University.
This SOP covers the end-to-end processes for employee onboarding, offboarding, leave management, performance management, and recruiting.
This role is to coordinate, track, and ensure compliance deadlines are met.

Crestwood University is a private university with approximately 1,400 employees, including full-time staff, part-time staff, and faculty, across three campuses in Colorado (Main Campus in Ridgefield, West Campus in Lakewood, and the Downtown Center in Denver).
The university employs approximately 620 full-time staff, 280 part-time staff, and 500 faculty members.
Crestwood operates on a fiscal year of July 1 through June 30 and an academic calendar of fall and spring semesters with a summer session.
